... vs In Re: Dhruba Saha
& Anr on 3 October, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
 03.10.2024
 Court No.29
 Item No. 57
 Allowed
 ar
 Crm (A) 3559 of 2024
 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Secti
 Criminal Procedure corresponding to 482 of the Bharatiya
 in connection with Ganga Sagar Coastal Police Station Ca
 dated 24.02.2024 corresponding to G,R Case No. 343 of 20
 498A/313/406/506 of the Indian Penal Code.

And
 In Re: Dhruba Saha & Anr.
 Petiti
 Mr. Soumik Ganguli
 Ms. Sharmistha Das For the Petitioners
 Mr. Anowar Hossain
 Ms. Puspita Saha For the State

1.
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.
2. The complainant is the daughter-in-law.

3. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioners in the commission of the alleged offence and having regard to the medical report of the Sagar Rural Hospital whch has taken into consideration the charges leveled under Section 313 of the Indian Penal Code and the medical document does not prima facie show any force of abortion and on an undertaking of the petitioner that they shall return all the stridhan within one week from date,
we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioners is not necessary.

4. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners, namely, Dhruba Saha and 498A/313/406/506 Of The Indian Penal ... vs In Re: Dhruba Saha & Anr on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18757522/
1

Pratima Saha shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- each, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, subject to the satisfaction of the Signed By :
AMITAVA ROY High Court of Calcutta 4 th of October 2024 06:33:28 PM Arresting Officer and also to comply with the conditions as laid down in Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, corresponding to Section 482(2) of the BNSS,
2023.

The petitioner no. 1 shall meet the Investigating Officer once in a fortnight till the submission of the final report and the petitioner no. 2 shall cooperate with the investigation till the submission of the final report and on further condition that the petitioners shall appear before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Kakdwip, on or before 8th October, 2024 from date in connection with G.R Case No.
343 of 2024.
In the event of non- compliance of any of the conditions, the anticipatory bail shall stand automatically cancelled without any further reference to this Court.
5. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is allowed and the same is accordingly disposed of.
6. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J) (Uday Kumar, J) Signed By :
